````````````text
"""Resume full vision integration after the preserved pressure interruption.

Reuse the three qualified original component executions, and run the two full
integration commands once under their original live guards and allowances.
"""
import argparse
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path('/Users/carlos/Projects/slotstream')
BASE = Path('/tmp/slotstream-optimization-execution')
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / '.build/optimization/resumed-vision-prerequisites-v368'
ORIGINAL = BASE / 'current-vision-prerequisites-v332/run.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_vision_native_v332', ORIGINAL)
original = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(original)
core, c, digest, require = original.core, original.c, original.digest, original.require
CORE = original.CORE
NATIVE, EXACT, SECONDS = original.NATIVE, original.EXACT, original.SECONDS
assess = original.assess
REUSED = tuple(NATIVE)[:3]
RESUMED = tuple(NATIVE)[3:]
ADMISSION_GB = 22.2
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE / 'pressure-footprint-v341'))
from guard_with_footprint import guarded_run
core.guarded_run = guarded_run


def output_for(name):
    require(name in NATIVE, 'unknown original vision case')
    return (original.OUT if name in REUSED else OUT) / name


def proof_for(name, current):
    target = output_for(name)
    attempt, receipt, report = (c.read(target / file) for file in ('attempt.json', 'qualification.json', 'stdout.txt'))
    require(receipt.get('passed') is True and receipt.get('completed') is True
            and receipt.get('qualified') is True and receipt.get('exit_code') == 0
            and receipt.get('error') is None and receipt.get('cleanup_complete') is True
            and receipt.get('within_reservation') is True and receipt.get('vision_proofs_unchanged') is True,
            'original full vision execution did not pass and drain')
    require(receipt['attempt_sha256'] == digest(target / 'attempt.json')
            and receipt['stdout_sha256'] == digest(target / 'stdout.txt')
            and receipt['execution_receipt_sha256'] == digest(target / 'receipt.json')
            and attempt['command'] == current['native_commands'][name]
            and attempt['build'] == current['build'] and attempt['environment'] == {}
            and attempt['policy'] == current['policy'], 'native bytes, command, controls or live guard changed')
    return {'assessment': assess(name, report),
            'evidence': c.evidence(target, ['attempt.json', 'receipt.json', 'qualification.json', 'stdout.txt', 'stderr.txt'])}


def preserved_proofs():
    value = original.load()
    reused = {name: proof_for(name, value) for name in REUSED}
    failed = original.OUT / RESUMED[0]
    qualification = c.read(failed / 'qualification.json')
    require(qualification.get('passed') is False and qualification.get('completed') is False
            and 'pressure' in qualification.get('error', '').lower(), 'original pressure failure disposition changed')
    require(not (original.OUT / RESUMED[1]).exists(), 'the original unattempted MTP identity must remain unrun')
    return {'reused': reused, 'preserved_failure': {'directory': str(failed), 'sha256': c.artifact_hashes(failed)},
            'original_mtp_unattempted': str(original.OUT / RESUMED[1])}


def prepare():
    require(not (HERE / 'preparation.json').exists() and not OUT.exists(), 'already prepared or attempted')
    previous = original.load()
    dependencies = [ORIGINAL, original.HERE / 'preparation.json', CORE, core.HERE / 'preparation.json',
                    BASE / 'pressure-footprint-v341/guard_with_footprint.py',
                    BASE / 'pressure-footprint-v341/pressure_footprint.py']
    value = {'format': 'slotstream-resumed-vision-prerequisites-v1', 'prepared_at': core.now(),
             'build': previous['build'], 'shared_proof': previous['shared_proof'],
             'native_commands': previous['native_commands'], 'native': previous['native'],
             'exact_tower_geometries': previous['exact_tower_geometries'],
             'seconds_per_case': SECONDS, 'cleanup_seconds': 30, 'policy': previous['policy'],
             'startup_admission_gb': ADMISSION_GB, 'executor_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
             'dependencies': {str(p): digest(p) for p in dependencies},
             'preserved_proofs': preserved_proofs(),
             'classification': 'Prospective resumed original V304 vision integration after the pressure interruption and later user resumption/resource change. The three passed original components are reused with exact provenance. The two complete integration commands retain all original cases, 900-second work plus 30-second cleanup and original 13/10/3 GB live policy. A stronger 22.2 GB prelaunch admission and the previously qualified failure observer are additive. No serving measurement, default selection or activation.'}
    c.write_new(HERE / 'preparation.json', value)
    return {'prepared': True, 'reused_component_assertions': 157, 'reused_exact_tower_geometries': 8,
            'native_unrun': list(RESUMED), 'model_launched': False}


def load():
    value, previous = c.read(HERE / 'preparation.json'), original.load()
    require(value['executor_sha256'] == digest(Path(__file__))
            and all(digest(Path(p)) == h for p, h in value['dependencies'].items()), 'executor or observer changed')
    for key in ('build', 'shared_proof', 'native_commands', 'native', 'exact_tower_geometries', 'policy'):
        require(value[key] == previous[key], 'original source, work, cases or live guard changed')
    require(value['seconds_per_case'] == SECONDS == 900 and value['cleanup_seconds'] == 30
            and value['startup_admission_gb'] == ADMISSION_GB == 22.2,
            'original full allowance or conservative admission changed')
    require(value['preserved_proofs'] == preserved_proofs(), 'reused components or preserved failed evidence changed')
    return value


def run(name, deadline):
    require(name in RESUMED, 'only the two full original integrations may launch')
    core.allowance(deadline, SECONDS + 30)
    value = load()
    target = output_for(name)
    require(not target.exists(), 'attempted resumed vision native cannot retry')
    limit, before, thermal = core.readiness(deadline, SECONDS + 30, ADMISSION_GB)
    attempt = {'started_at': core.now(), 'deadline_utc': deadline, 'command': value['native_commands'][name],
               'environment': {}, 'build': value['build'], 'before': before, 'thermal_prelaunch': thermal,
               'policy': value['policy'], 'preparation_sha256': digest(HERE / 'preparation.json'),
               'classification': value['classification']}
    def assessment(code):
        load()
        require(code == 0, 'original full vision integration failed')
        return assess(name, c.read(target / 'stdout.txt'))
    result = core.execute(attempt['command'], target, SECONDS, value['policy'], assessment, limit, attempt)
    try:
        load()
        result['vision_proofs_unchanged'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        result['vision_proof_error'] = str(error)
        result.update(passed=False, completed=False, qualified=False)
    result['execution_receipt_sha256'] = digest(target / 'receipt.json')
    c.write_new(target / 'qualification.json', result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action', choices=['prepare', 'status', 'native'])
    parser.add_argument('--name', choices=RESUMED)
    parser.add_argument('--deadline')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    with (HERE / '.run.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if args.action == 'prepare':
            result = prepare()
        elif args.action == 'status':
            load()
            result = {'original_components': 'reused with verified provenance',
                      'resumed_cases': {n: 'attempted' if output_for(n).exists() else 'unrun' for n in RESUMED},
                      'model_launched': False}
        else:
            require(args.name is not None and args.deadline is not None, 'named case and full coordinated interval required')
            result = run(args.name, args.deadline)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)
    return 1 if args.action == 'native' and result.get('qualified') is not True else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
````````````

````````````text
"""Model-free checks for the current vision prerequisite adapter."""
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('vision_current_prerequisites', HERE / 'run.py')
v = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(v)


class Checks(unittest.TestCase):
    def report(self, name):
        title, count = v.NATIVE[name]
        return {'name': title, 'passed': True, 'items': [{'passed': True}] * count,
                'measurements': {g + '.reference_exact_bytes': 1 for g in v.EXACT.get(name, ())}}

    def test_original_commands_and_current_build(self):
        shared = v.core.load()
        commands, hashes = v.original.original_commands(shared['build'])
        self.assertEqual(len(commands), 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(hashes), 5)
        for name, command in commands.items():
            self.assertEqual(command[0], shared['build']['binary'])
            self.assertEqual(command[3], name)
            self.assertNotIn('--tokens', command)

    def test_all_assertions_and_exact_towers_required(self):
        for name in v.NATIVE:
            good = self.report(name)
            self.assertTrue(v.assess(name, good)['passed'])
            for mutate in [lambda r: r.update(passed=False), lambda r: r['items'].pop(),
                           lambda r: r.update(skipped='unavailable'), lambda r: r.update(name='other')]:
                bad = copy.deepcopy(good)
                mutate(bad)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    v.assess(name, bad)
            bad = copy.deepcopy(good)
            bad['items'][0]['passed'] = False
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                v.assess(name, bad)
            for geometry in v.EXACT.get(name, ()):
                for missing in [False, True]:
                    bad = copy.deepcopy(good)
                    field = geometry + '.reference_exact_bytes'
                    if missing:
                        del bad['measurements'][field]
                    else:
                        bad['measurements'][field] = 0
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        v.assess(name, bad)

    def test_deadline_and_preflight_refuse_without_attempt(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder, patch.object(v, 'OUT', Path(folder) / 'out'):
            with patch.object(v.core, 'execute') as execute:
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    v.run('integrated-vision-query', '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z')
                self.assertFalse(v.OUT.exists())
                with patch.object(v.core, 'allowance'), patch.object(v, 'load', return_value={}), \
                        patch.object(v.core, 'readiness', side_effect=ValueError('not ready')):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'not ready'):
                        v.run('integrated-vision-query', '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z')
                execute.assert_not_called()
                self.assertFalse(v.OUT.exists())

    def test_attempted_case_cannot_retry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder, patch.object(v, 'OUT', Path(folder)):
            (v.OUT / 'integrated-vision-query').mkdir()
            with patch.object(v.core, 'allowance'), patch.object(v, 'load', return_value={}), \
                    patch.object(v.core, 'readiness') as readiness:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'cannot retry'):
                    v.run('integrated-vision-query', '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z')
                readiness.assert_not_called()

    def test_preparation_cannot_be_overwritten(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder, patch.object(v, 'HERE', Path(folder)), \
                patch.object(v, 'OUT', Path(folder) / 'out'):
            (v.HERE / 'preparation.json').write_text('{}')
            with patch.object(v.core, 'load') as load:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'already prepared'):
                    v.prepare()
                load.assert_not_called()


    def test_reused_proofs_and_live_policy_remain_exact(self):
        current, old = v.load(), v.original.load()
        self.assertEqual(current['policy'], old['policy'])
        self.assertEqual(current['native_commands'], old['native_commands'])
        self.assertEqual(current['seconds_per_case'], 900)
        self.assertEqual(current['cleanup_seconds'], 30)
        self.assertEqual(current['startup_admission_gb'], 22.2)
        proof = v.preserved_proofs()
        self.assertEqual(sum(p['assessment']['assertions'] for p in proof['reused'].values()), 157)
        self.assertEqual(sum(p['assessment']['exact_tower_comparisons'] for p in proof['reused'].values()), 8)
        for name in v.REUSED:
            self.assertEqual(v.output_for(name), v.original.OUT / name)
        for name in v.RESUMED:
            self.assertEqual(v.output_for(name), v.OUT / name)

    def test_passed_components_cannot_be_reexecuted(self):
        with patch.object(v.core, 'execute') as execute:
            for name in v.REUSED:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'only the two'):
                    v.run(name, '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z')
            execute.assert_not_called()

    def test_changed_reused_report_refuses_preparation(self):
        original_read = v.c.read
        name = v.REUSED[0]
        path = v.original.OUT / name / 'stdout.txt'
        def read(p):
            value = original_read(p)
            if Path(p) == path:
                value['items'][0]['passed'] = False
            return value
        with patch.object(v.c, 'read', side_effect=read), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            v.preserved_proofs()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    start = time.monotonic()
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(Checks))
    record = {'passed': result.wasSuccessful(), 'methods': result.testsRun,
              'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'failures': len(result.failures), 'errors': len(result.errors),
              'executor_sha256': v.digest(HERE / 'run.py'), 'validator_sha256': v.digest(Path(__file__)),
              'model_execution': False}
    with (HERE / 'validation.json').open('x') as target:
        json.dump(record, target, indent=2)
        target.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
````````````
